entries.title: One series palette for the whole site: every series its own swatch, INDY NXT gold

values.label: the road (default): the three 2019 Formula F series as dark, mid and light violet, then blue, sky, green, sage, plum, rose and INDY NXT gold; every pair raced in the same year passes the colour-blind check. Places and the miles between tracks wear a rust-to-sand ramp no series uses
atlas: the six editorial hues (Formula F as blue steps, green, wine, teal, rust, violet), USF Pro 2000 sage, INDY NXT gold
before: the pre-round palette with each series split onto its own swatch, INDY NXT in black

entries.look: Career → His life in weeks, the chapters (INDY NXT's dots), the odometer, the travel map; then About and Data. Flip the three and watch the same series keep one colour everywhere. On Life in weeks, point at (or tap) a series in the key to light only its weeks.

entries.title: The odometer: colour and a read on every tile
entries.noswitch: new reads on tiles that had none; nothing to switch back to
entries.look: Career → the odometer. Point at (or tap) each: a series segment on On track; a bar on Distance (it thickens and reads its miles); a part of Time (timed, untimed, other sessions); any of the 619 dots on Other drivers (the shared card: series and year, name, races together), or a colour chip under them to light one series; a country on Places (its most-raced track pictured, races and years) or a track dot (that track); a cell on When it went wrong (the shared race card: P19 of 21, how it ended; a second tap opens the race).
